data.one_liner: Foldable and dual-screen support with the TwoPane widget and hinge angle sensor data.
data.what_it_does: Provides the TwoPane layout widget for handling foldables and dual screens, and access to hinge angle sensor data via DualScreenInfo. It adapts layouts based on display features like hinges automatically.
use_when: Building apps optimized for foldable devices or dual-screen hardware like the Surface Duo
Implementing side-by-side or top-and-bottom pane layouts that snap to hinges
Reading real-time hinge angle sensor data
avoid_when: Targeting strictly traditional single-screen non-foldable devices
Needing complex state management or navigation solutions
strengths: Simplifies dual-screen and foldable layouts with TwoPane
Provides direct access to hinge angle sensor events
Integrates seamlessly with MediaQuery display features
weaknesses: Only fully utilized on devices with actual hardware hinges or foldable screens
Limited to specific dual-screen and foldable form factors
data.setup_notes: Add dual_screen as a dependency in pubspec.yaml and import 'package:dual_screen/dual_screen.dart'.
